rules: No permanent station jumps from nonexistent to operational.
Construction time and material/personnel commitments must be represented at the appropriate simulation LOD.
Partial operation may expose only completed capabilities.
If the original need disappears before completion, construction may pause, cancel or be repurposed.
A facility can become obsolete or uneconomic and be mothballed/decommissioned.
Destroyed/abandoned stations remain historical objects until physically removed or otherwise resolved.
